messages:
Priya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — prepping QBR readout for partner ops. Need a final partner-level co-funding schedule and tier allocation for FY25 by EOD Wed. Link to draft: https://go.redwood/partner-qbr-sheet :eyes:
Carla (Program Manager): ack. Can you drop the current assumptions? I only see aggregated numbers and not per-partner caps.
Priya (Partnerships): Assumptions are at the bottom of the sheet. Short version: 3 pools — Marketplace (cloud listings), Hardware co-fund (OEM credits), SI enablement. Allocation algorithm: tier-weighted (Platinum 40%, Gold 30%, Silver 20%, Emerging 10%). See snippet:
```
Tier,Pool,Allocation
Platinum,Marketplace,40
Gold,Marketplace,30
Silver,Marketplace,20
Emerging,Marketplace,10
```
Ben (Finance): Finance note — we need to cap hardware credits per partner, not just %. Otherwise we risk overspend. What's the max per platinum partner?
Priya (Partnerships): Proposed caps = $75k/quarter platinum, $35k/quarter gold, $10k/quarter silver. Totals fit current commit but Ben please validate.
Evan (Marketing): Marketing flag — co-marketing requests must include a joint announcement plan or we'll deprioritize promo credits. Please add a "JA required?" column on the sheet.
Marta (Marketplace Ops): FYI: cloud marketplace promo credits are gated by partner registry status — I can run a sync and flag non-listed partners. Need at least 48h lead.
Carla (Program Manager): Quick product question — can we split the Marketplace pool into "Paid listing" vs "Featured promo"? ROI differs and stakeholders want separate scorecard metrics.
Priya (Partnerships): Yes — propose 60/40 split paid listing/featured promo. I updated the draft sheet, column added.
Ben (Finance): I'll run a sensitivity analysis on the updated split tomorrow AM. If any partner request exceeds cap, route exceptions to me + @Priya.
Priya (Partnerships): Action items:
- Carla: add JA column + split marketplace rows (due tomorrow)
- Ben: sensitivity + cap check (due tomorrow)
- Evan: update announcement criteria doc with minimum KPIs (due Fri)
- Marta: validate partner registry flags and surface blockers
Deadline: EOD Wed for final numbers and the QBR slide pack. :calendar:
DevOps-bot: Reminder: Quarterly budget lock window opens 1740000000-1740864000 (do not edit after lock). :warning:
Priya (Partnerships): thanks all — if you can't meet dates ping me directly. :thumbsup:
